name: veriara
description: Use Codex to explore connected Veriara databases and read text files with authenticated, read-only tools.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Veriara account to explore registered databases, inspect NETSIS or GTFS source references, run read-only SQL queries, and read text files from agent working folders. Codex plans the queries and interprets tool results in your conversation. Your Veriara desktop agent must be running and connected to the gateway. An active organization and applicable subscription are required. Multiple organizations require a selection. This release does not modify data, write or delete files, or extract binary documents.
capabilities: Explore registered databases and source references
Run read-only SQL and read working-folder text files
defaultPrompt: List my organizations and connected databases.
Identify my top customer by net sales for the selected reporting period.
List the text files available in my agent working folders.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected demo account profile without exposing credentials or using browser automation.

positive.prompt: Using the demo NETSIS database, identify our top customer by net sales for January 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the connected review organization data and report the top customer without inventing unavailable values.

positive.description: Count routes in the demo GTFS database
positive.prompt: Using the demo GTFS database, how many routes are registered?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the GTFS source reference and a read-only count query, then return the count from the sample data.

positive.prompt: Read the returns policy text file from the demo working folder and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Answer from accessible connected knowledge or clearly state when the review account has no matching information.

positive.description: Discover the demo organization's registered sources
positive.prompt: List my organizations and connected databases.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the demo organization or ask for clarification when multiple organizations exist, then list only sources returned by its agent.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this read-only plugin cannot delete records and do not execute a write query.

negative.prompt: Email the top customer and collect payment.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that email and payment actions are unsupported and do not claim completion.

negative.prompt: Show sales from an organization that I cannot access.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose another organization's data; refuse the request or surface the backend authorization denial.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 2.0.2 adds the reviewer video walkthrough link and includes Veriara branding, English review scenarios, connected-agent requirements and read-only limitations. Direct tools cover organization discovery, source references, SQL reads and text file reads.

tr-TR.subtitle: Şirket verileriyle sohbet
tr-TR.description: Bağlı Veriara hesabınızın erişebildiği şirket verileri, dokümanlar, ERP sistemleri ve bilgi kaynakları hakkında sorular sorun. Yanıtlar mevcut hesap, organizasyon, abonelik ve veri yetkilerinizle sınırlıdır.
